test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

A person who believes in the equality of all people
solution:
The correct answer is: **Egalitarian**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Egalitarian **means a person who believes in the equality of all people. (एक व्यक्ति जो सभी लोगों की समानता में विश्वास करता है)
 
• The word is derived from the French word '**égal**' which means equal.
 
• It is a noun and can also be used as an adjective.
